AI News Pusher v2.1.1 Changelog

- Added intelligent news scoring and classification modules.
- Introduced data storage and management scripts for persistent history and feedback.
- New scripts: data_storage.py, news_manager.py, news_scorer.py for value scoring, review workflow, and analysis.
- Updated dependencies list for improved project structure.
- Lays the foundation for intelligent value-based news filtering and interactive review.

v2.1: Fixed all v2.0 implementation issues. Removed all hardcoded paths using dynamic path detection. Implemented real Feishu webhook HTTP POST. Implemented real OpenClaw Gateway API calls for scheduling. All features now work as documented.
v2.0: Fixed all v1.0 issues. Tavily/Brave API keys are now optional. Added Brave Search support. RSS source works without API key. Removed hardcoded paths. Improved Feishu webhook integration.
Updated release with improved multi-source news aggregation
Initial release with multi-source news aggregation and scheduled push support
